james-carter.bio: James Carter covers national politics and policy from Washington, with a focus on Congress, elections and the federal government.

sophia-reyes.bio: Sophia Reyes reports on corporate deals, retail and the companies shaping the U.S. economy from New York, with a focus on mergers and workforce trends.

daniel-okafor.bio: Daniel Okafor covers markets, monetary policy and the Federal Reserve from New York, tracking how interest rates and inflation move stocks, bonds and household finances.

elena-petrova.bio: Elena Petrova reports on international affairs from London, covering diplomacy, science and major events across Europe, Asia and beyond.
